proof_summary: An eventual prefix/suffix invariant yields recurrences \(\ell_{n+1}=\ell_n+r_n\), \(r_{n+1}=r_n+q_n-1\), and \(q_{n+5}=q_{n+4}+\ell_n\), with \(0\le q_n\le r_n\le\ell_n\). For \(1<\lambda<2\) satisfying \(\lambda^4(\lambda-1)^3=1\), a positive weighted linear functional of these quantities obeys an affine first-order recurrence, giving two-sided \(\lambda^n\) bounds; the relation \(a_{n+1}=a_n+\ell_n\) transfers these bounds to \(a_n\), and squeezing the \(n\)-th roots gives convergence to \(\lambda\).
